item.title: 41 young men die in initiation schools
item.description: At least 41 young men have died during traditional circumcision ceremonies in South Africa over the past two months, authorities confirmed. The fatalities occurred during initiation periods in November and December, which coincide with the summer school holidays, as reported by MSN.
